# India Solution Events

> India Solution is Bengaluru's premier event management, wedding planning, catering, and staging organization. This file provides AI agents and Large Language Models with a clean roadmap of our services, offerings, and booking resources.

## Core Services

- [Wedding Planning](https://www.india-solution.com/services/wedding): Complete wedding planning, mandap stage setup, bridal makeup, floral backdrop, invitations, and photography.
- [Catering Services](https://www.india-solution.com/services/catering): Premium indoor and outdoor catering solutions serving from 10 to 500+ guests with diverse regional cuisines.
- [Corporate Events](https://www.india-solution.com/services/corporate-events): Conferences, seminars, product launches, networking events, corporate meetings, and awards ceremonies.
- [Birthday Parties](https://www.india-solution.com/services/birthday): Theme decorations, balloon decor, stage setup, and children's entertainment activities.
- [Stage Decoration & Stalls](https://www.india-solution.com/services/trade-show-exhibition-planning): Custom exhibition stalls, stage fabrication, backdrop design, and trussing.
- [Sound & Lighting Systems](https://www.india-solution.com/services/promotions): Professional JBL sound system rentals, intelligent stage lighting, LED screens, and audiovisual tech.
- [Pre-Wedding Ceremonies](https://www.india-solution.com/services/pre-wedding-ceremony): Sangeet, Mehendi, Haldi decor, and special bridal/groom entries.

## Company & Booking

- [About Us](https://www.india-solution.com/about): Our heritage, founder vision, Bangalore operations, and event management experience.
- [Event Inventory & Equipment](https://www.india-solution.com/inventory-demo): Direct equipment rental catalogue with enquiry cart for stages, lighting, decor, and furniture.
- [Client Testimonials](https://www.india-solution.com/testimonials): Verified client reviews and past event project feedback.
- [Celebration Circle Membership](https://www.india-solution.com/membership): Loyalty benefits, vendor partner privileges, and discounted event services.
- [Contact & Inquiries](https://www.india-solution.com/contact): Direct booking, quotation inquiries, and phone/email details for Bengaluru events.
- [Franchise & Partner Inquiries](https://www.india-solution.com/franchise): Business partnerships and event vendor collaboration details.

## Area-Wise Event Inquiries

- [Bengaluru Event Services Directory](https://www.india-solution.com/#popular-event-searches): Direct coverage across Bengaluru including Whitefield, Indiranagar, Koramangala, Jayanagar, Electronic City, and HSR Layout.
